children: MetroCity Bankshares is boosting its quarterly dividend by 6.9% to 31 cents a share, up from 29 cents.
The new payout, equal to $1.24 a year, represents a 3.6% annual yield based on the company's Thursday opening price of $34.51.
The dividend will be paid on Nov. 13 to shareholders of record as of Nov. 4.
